role: SwiftUI 'Get Me Back' safety screen: shows a compass arrow pointing back to the active breadcrumb trail's origin (bearing minus true heading), an honest GPS-accuracy ribbon, distance/origin label, Talk-to-AI, SOS dialing of a location-chosen emergency number, and end/discard trail actions; plus static emergency-number helpers reused by the assistant.
types: GetMeBackView: struct (View) — the Get Me Back screen, presented as a sheet from FitnessTabView+Sections.swift:41
GetMeBackView: extension — static emergency-number selection and SOS/dial-failure message text (also used by AppFactResolver+LiveNavigation.swift:402-406)
CompassArrow: struct (private View) — filled arrow path with blur glow scaled by fuzz
CardinalLabel: struct (private View) — one N/E/S/W letter offset 110pt and rotated around the dial
GPSAccuracyLevel: extension — this screen's colour/icon/arrow opacity/fuzz/ribbon label for each accuracy level
state: mem:GetMeBackView.didDisableIdleTimer (@State, true when this screen turned auto-lock off)
toplevel: @State initializers read UIScreen.main.brightness on every struct construction and call GetMeBackView.emergencyNumber(currentCountry:nil), which reads Locale.current.region. Environment: dependencies, dismiss, accessibilityReduceMotion, scenePhase. The screen classifies accuracy as GPSAccuracyLevel directly (compared with ==); the UI properties for each level are an internal extension of GPSAccuracyLevel at the end of the file. File-level header comment states arrow hides above 100 m and the view is offline-first.

units.does: Returns the BreadcrumbRecorder from the environment's AppDependencies location services (BreadcrumbRecorder.shared unless overridden).
True when the recorder's published CLAuthorizationStatus is .denied or .restricted; drives the location-denied banner.

branches.effect: returns false → no banner (notDetermined also shows no banner)

units.does: Returns recorder.activeTrail (the in-memory active BreadcrumbTrail or nil).
Returns the active trail's origin fix (first fix) or nil.

recorder.latestLocation, or nil when that fix's timestamp predates the active trail's startedAt (the recorder keeps the previous trail's last fix, which must not show accuracy or direction for a new trail).

branches.cond: a trail is active and the fix is older than its start

units.does: Returns recorder.latestHeading (latest CLHeading).
Country code of the ambient RoadGeocodingService's current reverse geocode if it was made within 5 km of the latest fix, else nil.
Emergency number for the current country (or region-derived fallback) via emergencyNumber(currentCountry:).
Straight-line distance in meters from latest location to the trail origin; nil if either missing.

branches.effect: true: returns CLLocation.distance; false: returns nil

units.does: Initial great-circle bearing (deg, north=0) from the latest (trail-current) location to the origin via the shared bearingDegrees(from:to:); nil if either is missing.

branches.cond: latest coordinate and origin coordinate both present

units.does: True when a latest heading exists with trueHeading >= 0 and headingAccuracy >= 0.

branches.effect: false: returns false; true: returns trueHeading>=0 && headingAccuracy>=0 (trueHeading is -1 when CoreLocation lacks a location to compute true north, so heading is also invalid then)

units.does: Arrow rotation = bearingToOrigin − trueHeading normalized to (-180,180]; 0 when bearing, valid heading or heading missing.

branches.cond: bearing exists, heading valid, trueHeading available
branches.effect: false: returns 0 (arrow straight up); true: computes normalized difference
true: returns mod−360 (negative = left); false: returns mod

units.does: Latest fix's horizontalAccuracy, nil without a fix.
GPSAccuracyLevel.classify of the current (trail-current) fix's accuracy: good <10, ok <30, poor <100, else/negative/nil waiting.
True only with a usable fix (accuracy not waiting), a valid compass heading and a bearing to an origin — the arrow's single visibility rule.
Headline string: 'No active trail', 'Waiting for origin fix…', 'Wait for a better GPS fix', the formatted distance to origin in the user's units, or an em dash.

branches.effect: returns 'Wait for a better GPS fix'

units.does: Root body: NavigationStack wrapping trailStack with alerts and lifecycle modifiers.
units.entry: SwiftUI body; GetMeBackView presented as sheet from FitnessTabView+Sections.swift:41 and in ScreenSnapshotTests

units.does: Vertical layout: optional denied banner, accuracy ribbon, arrow dial, headline, actions row, optional brightness settings panel; sets nav title and toolbar.

branches.effect: true: shows settingsPanel with move/opacity transition; false: omitted

units.does: Toolbar: settings toggle (trailing) and Done button (leading) that dismisses the sheet.
units.entry: SwiftUI toolbar; Done button action calls dismiss()

units.does: Trailing toolbar item containing settingsToggleButton.
Button toggling showSettings with animation; icon reflects state.

branches.effect: true: chevron.up.circle icon; false: slider.horizontal.3 icon

units.does: Spawns a MainActor Task awaiting VoiceConversationController.start() (no-op unless controller state is .idle).
Disclaimer sheet; on accept sets AssistantViewModel.hasAcceptedDisclaimer=true (persists to UserDefaults) and starts voice chat; interactive dismiss disabled.
units.entry: sheet content; onAccept closure invoked by DisclaimerSheet
calls: ext:DisclaimerSheet (declared outside repo Swift units per lookup)

units.does: Attaches end-trail alert, AI disclaimer sheet, SOS confirm alert (Cancel / Call → dialEmergencyServices, message from sosConfirmMessage with sosDialNumber) and dial-failed alert.
Attaches 'End this trail?' alert with endTrailAlertActions and explanatory message.
Alert buttons: Keep going (no-op), End and save (recorder.endAndArchive + dismiss), Discard (recorder.clearTrail deletes trail from disk + dismiss).
Adds onAppear → prepareScreenState, onDisappear → resetScreenState, and onChange(scenePhase) → handleScenePhase.

Back in the foreground with the screen up: restarts the ambient location service without prompting (backgrounding stops it; keeps the SOS country current) and re-applies the slider brightness if the user set one. Going to the background with a slider brightness set: hands back the brightness captured at appear.

branches.effect: restore systemBrightnessAtAppear; other phases do nothing

units.does: On appear: if the keep-screen-on setting is on and auto-lock is not already disabled by another flow, disables it and remembers that this screen did; starts AmbientLocationService (may prompt for location), resumes a restored breadcrumb trail, and snapshots system brightness into state.

branches.cond: setting on AND idle timer not already disabled
branches.effect: true: disables it and sets didDisableIdleTimer; false: idle timer untouched

units.does: On disappear: re-enables the idle timer only if this screen disabled it (whatever the setting says now), and, if the slider changed brightness, restores the brightness captured at appear.

branches.effect: true: isIdleTimerDisabled=false and flag cleared; false: left to whoever set it
true: restores systemBrightnessAtAppear and clears flag; false: brightness untouched

units.does: Orange banner: 'Location is off' heading, instructions to enable location, and Open Settings button.
HStack with location.slash icon and 'Location is off'.
Button opening the app's Settings page via UIApplication.openSettingsURLString.

branches.effect: true: opens Settings; false: silently nothing

units.does: Ribbon showing accuracy icon/color/label and, with a trail, the trail's GPS point count.

branches.effect: true: shows '<count> GPS points'; false: omitted

units.does: Decorative 240pt ring with four localized cardinal letters placed every 90°; hidden from VoiceOver.
Splits localized 'N E S W' into four letters; falls back to English letters if the translation doesn't yield exactly four.

Dial: rose ring + CompassArrow rotated by arrowRotationDegrees with accuracy opacity/fuzz, drawn only when showsArrow (fix, heading and bearing to an origin); a spinner while accuracy is waiting or an active trail has no origin yet, else the compass-unavailable note without a heading; accessibility label from arrowAccessibilityLabel.

branches.effect: false: arrow opacity 0 (no fix, heading or origin)

branches.cond: accuracy waiting, or a trail without an origin fix

units.does: Text block showing compassUnavailableText in place of the arrow.
'Compass unavailable' plus bearing from north in degrees when a bearing exists.

branches.effect: false: 'Compass unavailable'; true: 'Compass unavailable. Your start point is N° from north.'

units.does: VoiceOver label for the dial: waiting text, compass-unavailable text, or distance plus relative direction.

branches.effect: returns 'Waiting for a better GPS fix'

units.does: Converts arrowRotationDegrees into 'straight ahead' (≤15°), 'behind you' (≥165°), or 'N° to your right/left'.
Headline VStack: big headline text, origin label, and 'Walked X out' when the trail has >1 fixes.

branches.effect: true: shows walked length; false: omitted

units.does: Shows originLabelText when a trail exists.
Origin caption: user label, else resolved address, else origin lat/lon, else nothing.
Stack of Talk-to-AI button and SOS/Clear row.
HStack of SOS and Clear buttons.
'Clear' button that opens the end-trail confirmation alert.
SOS button: freezes sosDialNumber to the current sosNumber and shows the confirmation alert.
Talk-to-AI button: starts voice chat if the AI disclaimer was accepted, otherwise shows the disclaimer sheet.
Settings panel with 'Screen brightness' title, slider row and explanatory caption.
Row with sun icons around the brightness slider.

Slider (0.05…1.0) whose setter writes UIScreen.main.brightness live and marks didSetBrightnessOverride, so it is restored on disappear and on backgrounding (handleScenePhase) and re-applied on return.
Formats a coordinate as '%.4f, %.4f' in the app locale.
Opens tel://<sosDialNumber>; shows the dial-failed alert if the URL can't be built or UIApplication.open reports failure.

branches.effect: false: show dial-failed alert and return; true: open URL

units.does: Static map from ISO region to emergency number: 911 US/CA/MX/AS/GU/PR/VI/PH, 999 GB/IE/HK, 000 AU, 111 NZ, 119 JP/KR/TW, 120 CN, 193 BR, otherwise 112.
SOS number: the current country's number when known; otherwise the phone Region's number only if it is 112/911, else 112.
Uppercased countryCode of a RoadContext if context and location exist and the context was observed within 5 km of the location; else nil.

branches.effect: false: nil; true: countryCode?.uppercased() (nil if geocode had no ISO code)

units.does: Display string: number alone if it is 112, otherwise '<number> / 112'.
SOS confirmation message: calling-device text with number(s) and Emergency SOS/satellite guidance, or call-from-a-phone text on iPad/Mac.

branches.effect: false: callFromAPhoneMessage; true: formatted SOS guidance

units.does: Dial-failed message: dial manually / Emergency SOS guidance, or call-from-a-phone text on iPad/Mac.

branches.effect: false: callFromAPhoneMessage; true: formatted dial-manually guidance

units.does: Message telling iPad/Mac users to call emergency services from a phone, with the number(s).
False when running as iOS app on Mac or when UIDevice.model starts with 'iPad'; true otherwise.
Draws the arrow twice: a blurred 25%-opacity glow (blur = fuzz) and a solid fill at the given opacity, 60×180pt.
Path of the arrowhead polygon (tip at y=-90, notched tail).
Cardinal letter offset 110pt up then rotated by angle around the dial centre.
Ribbon colour: green good, yellow ok, orange poor, red waiting.
Ribbon SF Symbol: location.fill / location / location.slash / antenna-slash for waiting.
Arrow opacity: 1.0 good, 0.85 ok, 0.6 poor, 0 waiting.
Arrow blur radius: 0 good, 1.5 ok, 5 poor, 10 waiting.
Ribbon text 'GPS strong/ok/poor (±Nm)' in the app language; the waiting text when the level is waiting or the metres cannot be shown (GPSAccuracyLevel.displayMetres nil).
